name: Cooperative/Team Challenge
summary: Teams work together against an environmental challenge (rising lava, escaping ship, building farm). Individual correct answers contribute to shared progress; collective failure reinforces interdependence.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates questions excellently. Cooperative shells are pre-built templates. AI fills with thematic narrative and questions. Progress tracking and collective scoring are deterministic.

questionMechanic.description: ID of the wrapped question mechanic (e.g., 'multiple-choice', 'short-answer').

questions.description: Array of question objects conforming to the wrapped mechanic's schema.

narrative.description: Story framing (e.g., 'Your submarine is sinking. Answer questions to pump water out before we hit the ocean floor.', 'Lava is rising. Answer to raise the platform.').

targetScore.description: Total points/progress needed to win (e.g., 50 questions answered, 500 progress points).

timeLimit.description: Time limit in seconds for the entire challenge (typical 300-600s for 5-10 min sessions).

penaltyForWrongAnswer.description: Optional penalty (e.g., lose 5 points or 10 seconds) on incorrect answer (can reduce team health/time).

reviveOrCheckpoint.description: Whether team gets a revival/checkpoint mechanic on collective failure (optional).

participationTracking.description: Whether individual contribution is visible to team (can motivate but also pressure).

ux.mobileNotes: Large shared progress visualization (top 50%): animated bar, lava rising, or avatar climbing. Question in center (30%). Individual contribution meter visible but not overwhelming (bottom 20%). Team member count/names in status bar. Real-time collective score updates with celebratory particle effects on milestones.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Small teams (3-4 players). Simple narrative (e.g., 'Save the animals!'). Generous time (300s+) and low target score (25-30 questions). No penalty for wrong answers. Encouraging tone; focus on collaboration.
ageAdaptations.11-13: Medium teams (4-6 players). Moderate narrative complexity (e.g., 'Escape the cave before the earthquake'). Standard time (300s) and target (40-50 questions). Small penalty for wrong (lose 5 points). Individual participation visible but de-emphasized.
ageAdaptations.14-16: Larger teams (6-8 players). Complex, branching narrative (e.g., 'Multi-stage farm survival'). Tight time (180-300s) and ambitious target (60+ questions). Penalties for wrong answers. Full participation transparency and optional discussion chat. Leaderboard for team completion times.
